ThingDef.label: shojin ryori
ThingDef.description:
Shōjin ryōri is the name of an assortment of vegan dishes traditionally served at Japanese temples and shrines that teach or support the values ​​of shugendō, as well as at temples of Zen Buddhism.
Originally consumed by mountain monks called yamabushi, shōjin ryōri does not use any products of animal origin, which is part of a strict and rigorous practice of Buddhist teachings.
To prepare this dish, you will need a rice base, then various vegetables of your choice.
